simple.meaning: צְפַנְיָה (Tsᵉphanyâh) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood and in connection with prophetic witness.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Jeremiah, Zephaniah, Zechariah, beginning at 2 Kings 25:18. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, priesthood, prophetic witness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְפַנְיָה (H6846) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows צְפַנְיָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: צְפַנְיָה (Tsᵉphanyâh) / H6846 is tracked through 2 Kings 25:18, 1 Chronicles 6:21, Jeremiah 21:1, Jeremiah 29:25. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

timeline.evidenceText: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

“Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.
Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.”
The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold:

Yahweh’s* “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
“Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
The crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.

definitions.short: Tsephanjah , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H6846. Tsephanyah or Tsephanyahu צְפַנְיָה(וּׅ proper name, masculine Σοφονιας ( ׳י hath treasured ; Old Hebrew צפניהו , Phoenician צפנבעל ); — 1 priest , יָה - Jer 21:1 ; 22:25 , 29 ; 52:24 = יָהוּ - 2Kin 25:18 ( ᵐ5 L Σαφανιας ), Jer 37:3 . Elsewhere יָה -: 2 the prophet Zeph 1:1 . 3 a Judaean Zech 6:10 , 14 . 4 ancestor of Heman 1Chr 6:21 ( Σαφανιας ; = אוּרִיאֵל v. 6:9 ).
definitions.rootNote: or צְפַנְיָהוּ ; from 6845 and 3050 ; Jah has secreted ;
